messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: unable to start device PNG
parts:
My guess is that you probably compiled R without the proper support for cairo, which R uses to create PNG's.

See this discussion - the solution (in the last comment of the answer) was to recompile R with cairo support: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/17243648/cant-display-png/17955000

-Winston

messages.subject: Re: unable to start device PNG
parts:
Hello,

That's the session information from the computer running Shiny Server. I launched the application by typing http://129.78.94.155:3838/survival/ into the Mozilla Firefox address field. Note that this server is part of the university network and not publicly accessible. png(tempfile()) is successful.

> png(tempfile())
>

I added the option to the top of my server.R file

library(shiny)
library(survival)
options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 2 * 1024^3)
options(bitmapType='cairo')

but it did not have any effect.

Interestingly, the server status command does not work :

$ sudo stop shiny-server
shiny-server stop/waiting
$ sudo start shiny-server
shiny-server start/running, process 4407
$ status shiny-server
status: Unknown job: shiny-server

It seems that this will be a difficult issue to find.
